# Cigala Cycling Coaching

> Online cycling and triathlon coaching by Matteo Cigala, an Italian coach based in Wicklow, Ireland. 28 years in cycling, over a decade of coaching, 200+ race wins; European Road Champion Gran Fondo, Vice-World Champion UCI Gran Fondo and UCI Gravel, Italian Gravel Champion. Coaches riders of every level worldwide, from first sportives to WorldTour professionals. Company: Cigala Cycling Ltd, Ireland.

Coaching is fully personalised, built on Critical Power and W′ (not just FTP), planned in Vekta or TrainingPeaks and synced to Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift and other devices. Packages: Basic (12-week plan, €228 one payment), Advanced (€149/month, weekly feedback and a monthly call, most popular) and Premium (daily contact; waiting list). Riders under 23 get a 20% discount. Nutrition coaching is available with sports nutritionist Marine Lenehan (WorldTour professional with LIDL-TREK).

- [INSCYD metabolic testing](https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/testing/)

- [Workshops for clubs](https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/club-talk/)
